name: £10K Monthly Income Engine
outline:
Multi-stream income project targeting £10,000/month through:

1. YOUTUBE CHANNEL - Create and publish videos to generate ad revenue, sponsorships, 
   and affiliate income. Target: 300,000-500,000 views/month.

2. INSTAGRAM (AI INFLUENCERS) - Create and publish content using AI-generated 
   influencer personas. Target: 100,000 views/month.

3. TIKTOK (AI INFLUENCERS) - Create and publish short-form content using AI-generated 
   influencer personas. Target: 500,000 views/month.

4. COLLECTIBLES TRADING - Purchase Pokemon, One Piece, and Dragon Ball collectibles 
   at prices that can be resold for profit. Identify limited editions and items that 
   will appreciate in value over time.

Each revenue stream should generate £2,000-£5,000/month.

goals.title: YouTube Revenue Stream
goals.description: Build a YouTube channel generating consistent ad revenue, sponsorships and affiliate income through engaging video content

goals.title: Instagram AI Influencer Revenue
goals.description: Create AI influencer personas on Instagram that generate income through brand deals, affiliate marketing and content monetisation

goals.title: TikTok AI Influencer Revenue
goals.description: Create AI influencer personas on TikTok that generate income through creator fund, brand deals and affiliate marketing

goals.title: Collectibles Trading Profit
goals.description: Buy Pokemon, One Piece and Dragon Ball collectibles at wholesale/discounted prices and resell for profit. Identify limited editions with future appreciation potential

goals.title: £10K Monthly Income Target
goals.description: Achieve combined monthly income of £10,000 across all revenue streams

strategies.title: YouTube Revenue Stream Strategy
strategies.description: Build a faceless/AI-assisted YouTube channel in a high-CPM niche. Focus on consistent uploads, SEO-optimised titles/thumbnails, and scaling to 300K-500K views/month through shorts + long-form.
actions: Identify top 3 high-CPM niches with AI content potential
Set up YouTube channel with professional branding
Create content production pipeline (scripting, voiceover, editing)
Publish 3-5 videos per week minimum
Optimise for YouTube algorithm (CTR, watch time, engagement)
Monetise via AdSense, affiliates, and sponsorships
strategies.rationale: YouTube ad revenue at 300K-500K views/month in a £4-8 CPM niche can generate £1,200-£4,000/month from ads alone, plus affiliate and sponsorship income.

strategies.title: Instagram AI Influencer Strategy
strategies.description: Create 2-3 AI-generated influencer personas using tools like Midjourney/Flux. Build engaged followings in lifestyle, fitness, or fashion niches. Monetise through brand deals, affiliate links, and digital products.
actions: Design 2-3 AI influencer personas with consistent look/personality
Set up Instagram accounts with professional bios and branding
Create content calendar: 1-2 posts/day + 5-10 stories/day + reels
Use hashtag strategy and engagement pods for growth
Reach out to brands once at 10K+ followers
Set up affiliate links in bio and stories
strategies.rationale: AI influencers with 50K+ followers can earn £500-£2,000 per brand deal. With 2-3 accounts and regular deals, £2,000-£5,000/month is achievable.

strategies.title: TikTok AI Influencer Strategy
strategies.description: Create AI influencer personas for TikTok focusing on viral short-form content. Leverage TikTok's algorithm for rapid growth. Monetise through Creator Fund, brand partnerships, and affiliate marketing.
actions: Create AI personas optimised for TikTok's younger demographic
Develop content templates for rapid production (3-5 posts/day)
Focus on trending sounds, hashtags, and formats
Build to 1,000 followers fast for Creator Fund eligibility
Cross-promote between TikTok and Instagram
Pursue TikTok Shop and affiliate commissions
strategies.rationale: TikTok's algorithm favours new accounts with viral potential. 500K views/month with Creator Fund + brand deals can yield £2,000-£5,000/month.

strategies.title: Collectibles Trading Strategy
strategies.description: Source Pokemon, One Piece, and Dragon Ball collectibles below market value. Focus on sealed products, graded cards, limited editions, and items with appreciation potential. Resell via eBay, Mercari, and specialist platforms.
actions: Research current market prices for target collectibles
Identify wholesale/discount sourcing channels
Track upcoming limited edition releases and pre-order windows
Build inventory of items with verified appreciation trends
Set up seller accounts on eBay, Mercari, TCGPlayer
Develop pricing model: minimum 30% margin per item
strategies.rationale: The collectibles market for Pokemon, One Piece and Dragon Ball is strong with predictable appreciation patterns on sealed/graded products. £10K inventory turning at 35% margin = £3,500/month.

strategies.title: Cross-Stream Revenue Optimisation
strategies.description: Maximise total income by cross-promoting between all channels, reinvesting profits from early wins, and diversifying income sources within each stream.
actions: Cross-promote YouTube <> Instagram <> TikTok content
Reinvest first profits into scaling highest-performing stream
Build email list across all platforms for direct monetisation
Track all revenue streams in unified dashboard
strategies.rationale: Cross-promotion accelerates growth across all platforms. Unified tracking ensures the £10K target is hit by optimising resource allocation.

methods.title: AI Content Pipeline
methods.description: Use AI tools (ChatGPT for scripts, ElevenLabs for voice, Midjourney/Flux for visuals) to produce content at scale with minimal manual effort

methods.title: SEO-First Publishing
methods.description: Every piece of content is optimised for platform discovery: YouTube SEO, Instagram hashtags, TikTok trending sounds

methods.title: Data-Driven Iteration
methods.description: Weekly analysis of metrics across all platforms. Double down on what works, cut what doesn't

methods.title: Buy Low Sell High Collectibles
methods.description: Source collectibles at 30%+ below market value through wholesale, clearance, and arbitrage. Only stock items with verified demand

methods.title: Cross-Platform Amplification
methods.description: Repurpose content across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok to maximise reach from each piece of content
